description:
Removes `LdpcDecoder::decode_batch` and `decode_batch_with_config`, so `gf2-coding` holds one batch decoding path.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. A pooled batch decoder over the trait gives parallel decoding with one inner decoder per worker. `LdpcDecoder::decode_batch` and `decode_batch_with_config` predate the trait: they build one single-frame decoder per frame, on rayon under the `parallel` feature, and return message bits with iteration counts and flags. Their tests, their benchmarks and the how-to page that showed them use the batch soft-decoder trait, so the functions have no caller in the workspace.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `LdpcDecoder::decode_batch` and `decode_batch_with_config` do not exist, and no alias or wrapper of them remains.
- [hard] REQ-02: The workspace builds with every feature, and no source, test, benchmark, example or permanent page names either function.
title: Remove the inherent LDPC batch functions
